_comment: 15 evaluation cases (plan section 10). expectedStatus: answered (supported or partial), insufficient, any. expectedDocumentIds: the answer must cite at least one of them. expectedFacts are for the manual review; the runner does not judge them. Cases marked needsCorpus fail until T03 adds those documents.

cases.question: ¿Cómo ejecuto HTG en local?
expectedFacts: Steps to clone, configure and run the backend locally

expectedFacts: How Excel columns are mapped to HTG fields

¿Qué escenarios debo probar en el Excel Import?
